description: This file defines the interface for the Network plugin in the WPEFramework, including method signatures, class declarations, and comments describing its purpose for managing network interfaces, JSONRPC communication, and event handling.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network plugin class that handles network interface management, JSON-RPC communication, and related events within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves quirks or specific features supported by the network plugin.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Gets a list of network interfaces.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the set-top box.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Sets the API version number.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumberWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves the API version number.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs a network trace (ping) to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: traceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a trace to a named endpoint.

methods.name: getNamedEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves a list of named endpoints.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends ICMP echo requests to test reachability of an endpoint.

methods.name: pingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Pings a named endpoint.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current IP settings.

methods.name: onInterfaceEnabledStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when an interface's enabled status changes.

methods.name: onInterfaceConnectionStatusChanged
methods.description: Callback for changes in interface connection status.

methods.name: onInterfaceIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Callback when a network interface's IP address changes.

methods.name: onDefaultInterfaceChanged
methods.description: Callback when the default interface changes.

methods.name: eventHandler
methods.description: Static method to handle IARM events.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Instance method to handle IARM events.

methods.name: _getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the default network interface and gateway.

methods.name: _doTrace
methods.description: Performs a network trace to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: _doTraceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a network trace to a named endpoint.

methods.name: _doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping to a specified endpoint with a GUID.

methods.name: _doPingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a ping to a named endpoint with a GUID.

methods.name: Network
methods.description: Constructor for the Network plugin class.

methods.name: ~Network
methods.description: Destructor for the Network plugin class.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin before shutdown.

methods.description: Returns plugin information.
